content:
HOOK_TEXT: Your CEO won't text you gift cards
SAY: Your CEO would never email you at 11pm asking for gift cards.
ON_SCREEN: "Urgent - are you at your desk?"
BROLL: Mock email from a fake brand with a spoofed executive name
SAY: But scammers know something about your brain. It's called authority bias. We obey titles without checking.
ON_SCREEN: Authority bias = trusting the title, not the proof
SAY: So they copy a boss's name, tone, and signature. Then add secrecy and a deadline.
ON_SCREEN: Red flags: secrecy + urgency + unusual payment
BROLL: Highlight the red flags in the mock email
SAY: Here's the fix. Don't reply to that email. Call the person on a number you already have.
ON_SCREEN: Verify on a second channel you trust
SAY: A real boss will thank you for double-checking. A scammer will push back.
SAY: Save this, and send it to someone in finance.
ON_SCREEN: Save + share
TITLE: Why scammers pretend to be your boss
CAPTION: Authority is a mental shortcut attackers borrow. A title in the From line is not proof. Verify payment or login requests through a second channel you trust. Who on your team needs this? #SocialEngineering #BEC #CyberAwareness
